name: warning
expr: lastwarn(''); warning('off', 'all'); warning('TestId:w', 'msg'); [~, lid] = lastwarn(); warning('on', 'all'); r1 = double(strcmp(lid, 'TestId:w'));
comment: Side-effect smoke test (warning() side-effect via lastwarn). warning('id', 'msg') sets lastwarn -- id is round-tripped through the warning subsystem.
